# jamfpro_v1_api_integration (Resource)

Get specified API integration object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

resource "jamfpro_v1_api_integration" "example" {
  authorization_scopes = ["tfacc-authorization-scopes-element"]
  display_name         = "tfacc-display-name"
  enabled              = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authorization_scopes` (Set of String) API Role display names.
- `display_name` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)

### Optional

- `access_token_lifetime_seconds` (Number)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `app_type` (String) Type of API Client: * `CLIENT_CREDENTIALS` - A client ID and secret have been generated for this integration. * `NATIVE_APP_OAUTH` - A native app (i.e., Jamf Reset) has been linked to this integration for auth code grant type via Managed App Config. * `NONE` - No client is currently associated with this integration.
- `client_id` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
